text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the checklist I1, to 
be performed 
every four years
as indicated by Y4 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ibrahem 
Ibrahem Shehata, tested by eng. Saber 
Abed Elkader at 05 Jan 2003 on 
Bustie coupler Sues Cement 220kv substation, and revised by quality control eng. 
Mohamed Omran, accepted by general director eng. Sohair Nageb Zaki and approved 
by eng. Farg Aly El-Azab Head Sector of West Canal Network, Canal Zone, ETEC.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes safety harness
Circuit 
breaker isolation and earthing is required.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, Safety shoes
Safety helmet, Safety shoes
Work to be Carried Out
Visually check SF6 pressure and, if the values don't tally, test the pressure gauges 
 and check the breaker for leaks.
Read and record the counter reading.
Examine paint finish and touch up damaged sections.
Check the oil level.
Examine all pipe joints for correct sealing.
Measure the provisional nitrogen pressure on the oil side.
Carry out the test operations.
Tighten all terminals.
